description.value: The Blind Angler is a full-service lakeside restaurant on Beach Avenue in Peachland, named after a legendary local figure who continued fishing on Lake Okanagan after losing his sight in WWI. The restaurant sits overlooking the marina with views described as among the best in the Okanagan, and serves everything from eggs benedict at breakfast to seafood and steaks at dinner. It is a notable stop for cyclists riding the Okanagan lakefront corridor.
